skills.description: Creating a Nuxt.js project and understanding directory structure
skills.example: npx create-nuxt-app myapp; // Project structure: pages/, components/, layouts/, plugins/

skills.description: File-based routing system in Nuxt.js with dynamic routes
Creating custom layouts for different pages
Creating and using reusable Vue components in Nuxt
Creating and using composable functions for logic reuse
skills.example: export const useCounter = () => { const count = ref(0); return { count } }; const { count } = useCounter();

skills.description: Creating backend API endpoints with server/api directory
skills.example: // server/api/users.ts exports default defineEventHandler(() => { return { users: [] }; })

skills.description: Creating route middleware for authentication and guards
skills.example: // middleware/auth.ts defineRouteMiddleware((to, from) => { if (!isAuthenticated) return navigateTo('/login'); })

skills.description: Managing global state using Pinia store
skills.example: export const useUserStore = defineStore('user', { state: () => ({ user: null }), actions: { setUser(u) {} } })

skills.description: Using useFetch, useAsyncData, and $fetch for data retrieval
skills.example: const { data: users } = await useFetch('/api/users'); const data = await $fetch('/api/data');

skills.description: Building and deploying Nuxt.js applications to production
skills.example: npm run build; npm run generate; // Deploy to Vercel, Netlify, or Node.js server
